notes.title: [RUMBLE BLAZING Update] Big Changes to the Camera System and more...
notes.content:
RUMBLE BLAZING has been updated.

The main changes are as follows:

Addendum:
Regarding the Steam version, I believe the F9 key is set to take screenshots by default in the Steam settings.
We apologize for the inconvenience, but please change the settings or turn it off while playing.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]
ver_3020

Move: Added Back Hold

Move: Added prototype of Punishment Game: Shell Matching

Costume: Added Ring Costume

Costume: Added option to select stockings at character select

Camera: Overhauled camera system

Camera: Added system for switching cameras during move loops

Graphics: Fog and Tone Mapping can now be toggled with F8/F9 keys (temporary implementation)
（The in-game update section says F9/F10, but it should be F8/F9.
　We will correct this in the next update.）
Graphics: Adjusted and optimized lighting in the following stages:

Forest Stage

Test Stage

Test Arena (Prototype)

Test Club (Prototype)

Other: Adjusted face lighting

Other: Test Stage mob characters now respond to the Stage Mob option

Other: Added UI hide function (R Trigger)

Other: Adjusted character axis during moves

Other: Fixed animation-related issues

[h1]Notes on This Update[/h1]
This update includes major internal changes, particularly related to camera systems and lighting.
If your PC has previously met the requirements without issue, it should continue to run smoothly.
However, on lower-end systems, performance impacts are unpredictable.

For this reason, we have kept the previous version available in the Beta branch.
If you encounter issues with the latest version, please try switching back.

You can also reduce the graphic settings and resolution from the options menu to improve performance.
Lowering the resolution has a particularly strong effect on FPS.
For example, on our lowest-spec test PC:

At 2560×1440: ~30 FPS

At 1280×720: ~60 FPS

Reference Test Specs (not recommended specs):

Intel Core i7 3820 3.6GHz

Nvidia GeForce GTX660 2GB

RAM: 16GB

[h1]Main Update[/h1]
The primary change this time is the new camera system.
In addition to existing camera controls, you can now switch between three camera placements during grappling moves.

Because each move required its own camera angle, we prioritized implementation speed while avoiding cutting corners.
These will be refined further in future updates.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]
You can now switch Fog and Tone Mapping during matches.
By combining Fog on/off with three Tone Mapping modes, a total of six graphic variations are possible.
Please experiment to find your preferred look and style.

Currently, this feature is in testing and visual preferences cannot be saved.
We plan to allow changes via the pause menu in a future update.

[h1]Costumes[/h1]
One new costume (Ring Costume) has been added.
Additionally, a test feature allowing stockings to be selected at character select has been implemented.
(This remains in testing as improvements are planned.)

[h1]Moves[/h1]
A new move from the back has been added.
A work-in-progress move has also been added to the punishment game.

Lighting adjustments and optimizations have been applied to the Forest Stage and “TEST” stages,
resulting in significantly updated visuals.

[h1]Other[/h1]
Due to the new camera system, characters were often hidden behind the UI.
To address this, a UI toggle function has been added.
By default, this is bound to the W key on keyboard and the R Trigger on controllers.


That's all.

For now, I'll be spending the next week preparing for bug reports,
debugging to confirm any issues, and deciding on future plans.

As for my next plans,
I have a lot of other things I want to do, such as adding moves, creating a proper male character, and improving the gallery mode,
so I'll be thinking about where to start next.

notes.title: [RUMBLE BLAZING] Update schedule and progress report
notes.content:
[h1]We noticed a mistake during debugging—[/h1]
I forgot to add a camera for the “punishment” scene after a match ends.

That said, there are fewer motions here compared to during the match.
Especially since there are fewer intro, exit, and release animations, it shouldn’t take too much time.

For the past few days I’ve been working on this extra task, and about 90% is done—
just one motion left to go.

So, while I originally planned the update for the 20th–25th, now that things are more concrete, I’ll be aiming for August 26th as the update date.


And there’s another addition:
While debugging the new camera system, something really started bothering me.

…The UI is in the way!!

Because the new camera sometimes zooms in pretty close, things like the HP bar end up being really distracting.

I already made it possible to hide the command list, but I figured it would be better if the whole UI could be hidden. Since it’s not too hard to implement, I went ahead and added that feature too.

Now, you can hide the UI by pressing the L trigger on the controller.
(It also works on keyboard.)


So with that, I’ll be working toward the 26th update release. Thanks for your patience!

Here’s a video compiling some of the debugging footage:
[previewyoutube=ZrFD03HZF2s;full][/previewyoutube]

Oh, and while working on the camera, I stumbled across an unfinished “punishment” motion, so I added a prototype version of that as well.

notes.content:
[p]Long time no see!
The heat lately has been brutal.
Recently, I’ve been going for walks early in the morning and around sunset to stay active and take care of my health.

Also, food and nutrition are so important!
I've been making sure to eat balanced meals and supplementing what’s lacking with vitamins.
Thanks to that, I’ve been feeling great lately!

DHA and citrulline supplements might actually be working pretty well for me. 😄

It looks like the hot weather will continue for a while, so please take good care of yourselves!

[/p][h1]A Quick Progress Update[/h1][p]I’ll go into more detail in the progress report at the beginning of August, but since I’ve reached a good stopping point, here’s a quick update.

Earlier this month, I was working on creating a new system for axes and cameras.

The camera system is now complete, and I’ve applied axis adjustments and added camera settings to all existing moves.

Currently, there are about three more moves that need fine-tuning. After that, I’ll run some debugging and plan to release an update.

Since the system has changed quite a bit, I’ll probably include the old version alongside the new one.
The new one will likely be labeled as a “Beta Version.”

If possible, I’d like to make use of Steam’s beta features too.

Thanks for your patience!

For now, here’s a video I posted on YouTube as part of the update.

New Camera System
This was during the prototype phase, so the camera was being changed using debug mode or the editor.
Currently, it’s set to change with the W key on keyboard and RB on controller.

notes.title: Return Announcement and Progress Update!
notes.content:
First of all, I want to sincerely apologize for taking a break without any updates for the past few months.
Thank you for your concern, and I’m sorry to have kept you waiting for an update.

Over the past few months, my health has been up and down, which made it hard to find the right timing to write updates.
However, I’m happy to report that my health has finally stabilized, so I’m officially back!

As I mentioned before, stress was likely a major factor in my condition. I thought I had recovered after taking a month off, but as soon as I started working again, my health started fluctuating every other day.
I was hesitant to share my situation because I wasn’t confident in my own recovery, and honestly, there were days when I thought it was all over, struggling with constant back pain that kept me up at night.

So, this time, I decided to fully step away from game development and focus on proper rest.

Last year brought a lot of changes, including the overwhelming response on Steam, which made me feel like I had to meet everyone's expectations.
That pressure, combined with the frustration of not being able to work as efficiently as I wanted, likely contributed to my stress.

I tried not to let it get to me, but it’s easier said than done. I’m the kind of person who tends to put a lot of pressure on myself, and I’ve come to accept that this probably won’t change.

This time, I made sure to take a proper break, completely stepping away from game development.

Over the past two weeks, I’ve felt great!
I’ve been exercising, building up my stamina, and feeling more energized than ever.

However, from now on, I won’t be saying, “I’m fine” so easily.
I might have another health setback, and if that happens, I’ll take a break again! (Consider this my insurance policy to be kind to myself, haha.)

Just to be safe, I’ll be sharing progress updates about once a month for the time being.

Once again, I deeply apologize for any concern or inconvenience I may have caused, and I appreciate everyone who’s been waiting for updates.
I’m truly sorry.

I’ll keep working hard to create a game that those of you who continue to support and enjoy my work will love, so I hope you’ll stick with me.

[h1]Progress Update Before and After My Break:[/h1]

While I couldn’t post any articles, here’s a brief update on what I’ve been working on before my break and over the past few weeks:

Camera System Experiments:

Testing new camera systems, including moving cameras during restraints and implementing multiple camera positions.

These are still in the experimental phase and will likely require modifications to existing animations, so it might take some time.

[h1]Update Details[/h1]
ver_3005

Move: Added standing kiss (female only)
Outfit: Added nurse outfit
Outfit: Modified the skirt for Little Devil outfit
Item: Added handcuffs
Shop: Added nurse outfit, outfit colors, and handcuffs to the shop
Physics: Adjusted physics for chest, hair, skirt, etc.
Options: Added a setting to adjust chest jiggle
Options: Updated the behavior of "Physics" under graphics settings
Other: Corrected typos in the options menu
Other: Temporarily made male character outfits destructible
Other: Fixed several bugs
Other: Investigating some bugs in the gallery

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]
I plan to take it easy during the year-end and New Year holidays.

After that, I’ll work on camera settings for moves.

Right now, I create animations in a modeling software and then set up the camera in the game engine.
But this process is quite tedious and hard to manage.

Ideally, I’d like to set the camera positions during animation creation.
This would make it easier to adjust multiple camera positions for a single move, and managing them would become much simpler.

I also plan to finish the incomplete motions that didn’t make it into this update.

[h1]End-of-Year Greetings[/h1]
Thank you for an amazing year!

I’m thrilled that so many people have played RUMBLE BLAZING!
Your comments, support, ideas, and bug reports mean so much to me.

Since this is my first time doing a lot of these things, development doesn’t always go as planned, but I’m committed to making a game that you all can enjoy!

I look forward to your continued support next year.

Please take care during the year-end cold wave, and have a wonderful New Year!

And may next year be a great one for catfight-themed games!

notes.title: 【RUMBLE BLAZING Progress Report】Kiss Animation Nearing Completion and Various Up
notes.content:
Feeling the increasing cold these days
Did you catch the Geminid meteor shower last night?

I totally missed it, haha.

Right now, I’m working on the final year-end update for this year!
Wait, is it really the end of the year already?!

I’ll keep pushing through!

[h1]Kiss Animation Almost Complete[/h1]
The kiss animation is finally at the stage where the facial expressions and tongue movements are complete.
What’s left is to create the unlock and disengage motions, and then do some fine adjustments like tweaking the fingertips and other small details.
It should be ready to integrate into the game in 2-3 days.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/d09c5fb1f31344a6d7739e384997747fb93713e2.png[/img]
The animation video can be viewed on the Cien website linked below.
[url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1072/article/1309266]https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1072/article/1309266[/url]

[h1]Struggles with the Disengage Motion[/h1]
For now, I plan to return both characters to a standing position after the disengage motion.
However, this raises questions like, “How did they get out of the handcuffs?”

Also, it feels weird if the handcuffs are still in their possession after breaking free.
I’m debating whether the handcuffs should remain in their inventory or be discarded after the move ends.

That said, if I overthink this and keep adding details, the workload will spiral out of control.
So, for now, I’m going with a more game-convenient approach:
they’ll break free from the handcuffs, but the handcuffs will still remain in their inventory after the motion ends.

[h1]Game Settings and Adjustments for the Handcuffs[/h1]
I’ve created and set up the UI for purchasing handcuffs in the in-game shop.
I also configured the settings for acquiring handcuffs during battles.

[h1]Adjustments to the Nurse Outfit[/h1]
I fixed some issues with clipping and other glitches in the nurse outfit that was added last time.

Miscellaneous
I’ve been working on a bunch of other things, but…
I totally forgot what they were, lol.

Future Notes
Regarding the Handcuffs

Currently, the handcuffs are implemented as something used during a move,
but in the future, I think it could be fun to make them part of a move that starts by attaching the handcuffs and then chaining into another technique.

This time, I tried using ChatGPT for the translation.
Which do you find easier to understand, this or Google Translate?

notes.title: [RUMBLE BLAZING Progress Report] Costumes and handcuffs added to the game and ot
notes.content:
The hardest thing for humans to do is maintain the status quo...

Yes, humans are greedy...

And so I did it... my back (lol)
Oh, it's not serious, so don't worry!

This is why I couldn't post a work report last week.

Well, I've been making good progress lately, so I got greedy and my work hours increased all at once.

Usually, I take a break every hour or two and go for a walk or jog once a day,
but when I'm feeling too good, I end up thinking, "I'll make a little more progress and then take a break..."

"Just a little more..." "I guess I can't exercise today..."

It happens every time, but when I'm calm, I can consciously take a break,
but when I get a mysterious boost, I lose myself or something... (lol)

That's why I thought sitting for a long time would make it worse,
so I cut down on my work a little last week and this week.

It usually takes about an hour to write an article about my progress,
so I took a break.

By the way, I'm almost recovered now.
But maybe because I'm an old man, my recovery is slow.

Here is a progress report.

Added nurse costume
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/6e093ad3a2150d33c8c8aac54a99eb4a8aecd88e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/c6bccfd57a359f437ab47ca34855833d9fc6219c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/b14e2dc6b32ee8f17b0c8ac20de0eb9182f4d0b3.png[/img]
I'm currently implementing nurse costumes into the game.
There are currently three colors: white and black, and pink, which isn't in the video.
As you can see in the video, there are large holes in the skirt, so I'm going to fix that.
All that's left to do is create an image for character selection and add the data to the shop, and the implementation will be complete.

Little Devil Costume Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/761e917750b13b6791d63bb220c555dd36c6d278.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/3500d1373ff06b34da7fff861af35ad328849e39.png[/img]
I've also improved the Little Devil costume.
The changes are to the skirt and the undressing pattern.
Please look forward to the undressing pattern when we update lol

Added item handcuffs
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/1b5f21dd9ae3d466f247cebbd113781d75568387.png[/img]
I'm adding a new item, handcuffs, to be used in the next standing kiss.
All that's left to do is apply the texture, create data and images for the shop, adjust the images to display during battle, and adjust the points for putting the handcuffs on the character, and it should be ready to implement.

Standing kiss motion

I'm still working on the loop part of the standing kiss motion.
It's roughly in shape, but the positions of the mouths and the movements of the tongues are very detailed, so it's taking time to adjust.

We are considering adding the option to choose stockings when selecting a character.

Currently, stockings are only available for some costumes,
but we are making the system so that they can be added to other costumes,
so we are looking into whether we can make them selectable when selecting a character.

The problem is loading images during a match.
Currently, if you want a specific stocking for a specific costume, you can just assign the corresponding image file, but if you make it selectable, you will need to load all the images once during a match.

This will increase memory and take time to load.
So we are looking into whether we can load only the necessary images at the right time.

Currently, there are two patterns, knee-high and pantyhose-shaped,
but considering the addition of colors and patterns in the future, it would be better to load only the necessary images.

For now, this is what it has been like from last week to this week.

Recently, I have been reporting my progress every week, but I would like to do so once every two weeks for a while.
When I can, I do it once a week, but basically I do it once every two weeks.

I've been staring at numbers all this time and I think I'm getting stressed out.
Also, my PC has been acting up a lot lately, so I'm feeling a bit worried.
I've been working a lot on 3D (lol)
Anyway, here's a progress report!

[h1]# A quick glossary of terms [What is MagicaCloth?][/h1]

Magica Cloth is a paid, swaying asset that can be used with Unity, the game engine used to create this game.

By installing this, you can make clothes, breasts, and hair sway with physical behavior within Unity.

In other words, you can add a function that makes things sway in various ways when the character moves.

[h1]# Migration to Magica Cloth2 almost complete[/h1]
I've been upgrading to Magica Cloth2 since last time, and I've finished migrating each character's breasts, hair, and clothes.

All that's left is to set the parameters for the fine amount of swaying.

The breasts still need a little more tweaking, but that's it. All that's left now is to adjust the outfit, especially the skirt.

The game also works fine when you play it as shown below.

So it looks like it'll be available in the next update.

[h1]# Optional breast movement pattern[/h1]
I've been studying Magica Cloth thoroughly this time, so I've been able to add some small options.

You can now change the way the breasts move as an option.

However, it's quite difficult to set the parameters for how much they move,
and if they move too much, they can penetrate the clothes or get crushed in a weird way,

so currently I've implemented four patterns,
with patterns 0 and 1 being stable versions that reduce penetration of clothes,
and patterns 2 and 3 being experimental versions for more intense movements.

Also, the way the breasts move also changes a lot depending on the bone movement,
so I'm going to keep an eye on this and adjust it as I go.

[previewyoutube=S30ZPX01yxI;full][/previewyoutube]

The video on the difference between bounces contains nudity, so I have uploaded it to Cien.
[url=https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1072/article/1285269]https://ci-en.dlsite.com/creator/1072/article/1285269[/url]

This time, for testing purposes, you can change the amount of shaking by pressing the F1 to F4 keys on your keyboard during a match.

However, I'm worried about changing the settings during gameplay, so I've quietly implemented it as it's not an official operation (lol).
In other words, it's a hidden function that only people who remember reading this article can use lol.

I'll announce it when I update it though!

[h1]# The nurse costume is almost complete.[/h1]
I've finished modeling, texturing, and skinning the nurse costume,

[h1]Interested in Unity6[/h1]
I've recently started to get a bit interested in Unity6.

It has new features and graphics processing seems to have improved,
so I'd like to introduce it if it can make processing easier, since it's a game with a lot of polygons.

I tried to upgrade my current project to Unity6 as is the other day,
and an error occurred with the Magica Cloth asset used for swinging,
but after deleting it, it seems to work fine.

but I need to make some changes to the program and fix the colliders,

so I'd like to upgrade.

I don't think there will be any problems playing the game,

albeit in early access.

So instead of doing it from the front, I changed it to when you get behind them.

notes.title: Next update planned
notes.content:
Last week I was pretty tired from working on the update, so I took it easy this week.

I mainly debugged bugs reported in the update and thought about what to do for the next update.

As for the goal of the next update,
I thought of a few candidates, so I'll write them down.

[h1]Two new techniques[/h1]
1. Slap from standing grab
I'm trying to make it more like a slap battle, where you slap each other, rather than ending it with one hit.
2. Standing kiss
It's the same, but I wanted to create a technique where you kiss while standing

When I introduced the command list, I noticed that there are not many techniques that start with a grab in a specific position.
There are multiple motions for each technique, so there are quite a few, but I still want to fill in the gaps in the commands.

[h1]Additions to existing techniques[/h1]
1. Add an Achilles tendon hold H technique
I divided it into the first and second stages, and in the second stage, I think I made it so that the hips are pressed against each other in a clamshell-like manner.
2. I want to add breast rubbing and groin attack to the cobra twist.

3. I want to add a H-move to the standing shame hold.

I want to summon a mob and have it penetrate me.

[h1]Adding costumes[/h1]
・I want to make a nurse uniform (I wish)

[h1]System related[/h1]
1. The player character destroys their own costume.

I want to keep the sense of modesty in mind, so I want to avoid having the player take off their costume.

What I'm thinking now is to summon a mob character and take it off by inputting commands, pressing PKT at the same time (or RB button).

(It will also help practice the mob character appearance system)

Or I could create a spot on the stage for a special move and summon a mob there by inputting the above command.

But still, the simplest and easiest thing to implement is to destroy it yourself...

Hmm, I'm having a hard time deciding.

2. Prototype missions for rewards during battle

I'll try adding the battle missions I mentioned some time ago.

For now, that was the next update planned.

There are so many other things I want to do that I'm not sure where to start...

Remaking the gallery mode,
adding mini-games,
adjusting male characters, etc...

These are just my current plans, and may change depending on the amount of time I have to work on them,
but for now I'll do my best to update with these contents, aiming for a completion date of about 2 months from now.

notes.title: New key configuration and button display related work
notes.content:
Thank you for all the ideas and bug reports in the thread!

I'm looking forward to reading all the interesting ideas.

[h2]Improving key configuration and display[/h2]

I'm still working on key configuration and button guides using displays.

I was told that it was hard to know which button to press on the title screen according to the key configuration,
so I'm improving the display.

Specifically, it detects the connection status of the gamepad, and when it's not connected, it displays the Confirm key on the keyboard.

For XInput controllers and Dual Shock controllers, it displays the Confirm button that corresponds to them.

The key configuration screen also displays the buttons that correspond to the controller.

[h2]About the update schedule and current work environment[/h2]

I'm currently moving, and my new house doesn't have internet yet.
The internet installation work will be done at the end of September, so I'll update it when the work is completed and I can connect to the internet.

The next update is scheduled for the end of September.

I wanted to update these command list real-time displays and new key configurations as soon as possible, but I'm currently using rented Wi-Fi, so I'm having problems uploading (tears)

So if I have the time, I'd like to add the skill motions I'm currently working on.

Also, since over 80% of the key configuration system has been remade, there is a possibility that there may be problems with data transfer.

I intend to test it in as many different situations as possible before updating, but if you encounter any problems, I would appreciate it if you could let me know.

notes.content:
We are currently producing some items that have been requested.

[h2]・Improved key configuration[/h2]
In the current version, the key configuration is changed one button at a time, so we have received reports that the key settings may overlap, so we are currently changing the specifications.

Specifically, we are making it possible to set key settings all at once.

notes.title: Future plans
notes.content:
I am currently in the middle of moving, so it looks like my work will be a bit delayed from this month until the beginning of next month.
However, my new home will provide a better work environment, so I would like to really improve my work efficiency after I move!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45078547/f9fd83a3ca3652782557781f4517d941cdafdcb1.png[/img]
So, here are my future plans.

I am aiming to update every 1-3 months.
I am basically aiming for about every 2 months.
There may be delays depending on the development situation.

The following are things I plan to implement in the future.
There are more things, but I can't write them all here so this is a list of the things I am currently prioritizing.

Basic work
- Creating skills, characters, costumes, and stages
- Adding H items
- Improve the CPU

New system
- Eliminating arcade mode and allowing the map to be moved in TPS
- Creating a mini-game for making money
(↑ Examples of current ideas)
　1. Massage
　2. Lotion wrestling
- Adding stage gimmicks (H skills exclusive to the stage, etc.)
- Special attacks when the heart gauge is at its maximum
- Improving or remaking the gallery mode
(Gallery mode was created early on and is difficult to maintain for additions and adjustments)
- H fighting mode
(A mode where the goal is to KO by orgasm, not KO by stamina)
- Increasing rewards for missions during battles ()
(Examples)
　1. Tear clothes at least twice during battle
　2. Win by submission
　3. Use H skills at least twice during battle
　4. Touch the upper body at least three times during battle
　　Etc...

I'm making this alone, so it will take time, but if you have any interesting ideas, I'd like to actively incorporate them, so I'd be happy if you could post your ideas on the community thread. (In that case, it's easier to adopt something that's easy to imagine as a game.)

We'll continue to work hard to make it so that you can continue to enjoy it, so please look forward to it.
